d: Is vidiyo men do. vikas divyakirti sar ne 1971 ke bharat-pak yuddh se lekar opreshan sindur 2025 tak ki ghatnaon ko saral aur spasht bhasha men samjhaya hai. unhonne in ghatnaon ki aitihasik prishthabhumi, bharat ki bhumika, aur bangladesh ke gathan ki paristhitiyon ko vistar se bataya hai. iske sath hi, yuddh aur sainy opreshan ke bich ka antar bhi bari sahajta se samjhaya gaya hai. opreshan sindur ki vartaman samay men prasangikta aur usse jure naitik mulyon va drishtikonon par bhi sar ne dhyan kendrit kiya hai. yah vidiyo UPSC, rajy lok seva aayog aur any pratiyogi parikshaon ki taiyari…
